x: Hunter, Robertson, Bailey and Harry Turner are new members as Seniors and Jim Purdy and Pete Hunt two promising Juniors. We have of course lost some of our Juniors to the Services, but there are a number of new ones to take their places.
Eales and Peter Hunt, had a first-class victory, with the latter running a very good 440 leg. Our senior team of Bob Taylor, Eric Bishop, Dicky Bartlett and D.
Frank Kemp won the junior 100 and was second in the furlong, and Peter Hunt finished second in the quarter, with Gerry Trower in a similar position in the half-mile.
Peter Hunt ran in the 200 yards Low Hurdles but was unlucky in that he had Duffy and Lawrence, who were first and third in the final, both running in his heat with two only to qualify.

Our relay team of Peter Hunt, Eric Bishop, Alan Law and Dicky Bartlett ran exceedingly well to finish only about five yards behind the Dorking boys, who were subsequently disqualified for a faulty baton-change, which gave us first place with Horsham Blue Star second.
